| INV-BONDS-03 | A time deposit's term is a non-empty forward window (maturity strictly after placement, else `ErrInvalidDepositTerm`/the migration CHECK), and it is enforced both ways: a snapshot's month must fall within placement..maturity (inclusive) on **every** write path, workbook snapshot import into an existing deposit included (400 `OUTSIDE_DEPOSIT_TERM` in the preview and the commit alike, nothing written, #911), the terminal Maturity transaction within placement..maturity to the day, and a term edit cannot be narrowed so it strands an existing snapshot or transaction outside the new window; **undo and terminate hold the window too** (#1002): undoing a snapshot delete, replace or move, or a transaction delete, re-checks the restored month/day in the same transaction and refuses with 400 `OUTSIDE_DEPOSIT_TERM` (nothing restored), and a lifecycle terminate refuses a termination month outside placement..maturity before the close snapshot is written, and, when it books a settlement Maturity, a termination day outside it | `backend/internal/investments/time_deposit_import_term_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/repo/time_deposit_term_bounds_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/repo/undo_term_window_test.go`<br>`frontend/src/components/dialogs/TerminatePositionDialog.test.tsx` |
| INV-BONDS-04 | A bond's `coupon_disposition` is a per-bond enum (`pays_out` \ | `backend/internal/backup/transform_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/investments/bonds_test.go` |
| INV-BONDS-05 | A bond's term is the window [earliest live Buy, `maturity_date`], both ends inclusive, derived from the ledger on every check (no stored placement, no `bond_details` column, #574): a bond's placement date is not in the future (400 `TRANSACTION_FUTURE_DATE`, the placement seeds a real Buy); maturity is strictly after the earliest Buy (else `ErrInvalidBondTerm` → 400 `INVALID_BOND_TERM`, on create, on a maturity edit, on moving/adding a Buy, on create-from-list); every snapshot month (month granularity) and every transaction date (to the day) lies inside the window on **every** write path — create, edit, move, workbook snapshot import and create-from-list seed, with the monthly bulk-entry list/write offering a bond only for in-window months — else `ErrOutsideBondTerm` → 400 `OUTSIDE_BOND_TERM`, nothing written; and no edit can strand history: editing the maturity, moving or deleting the earliest Buy, or adding a first Buy later than existing entries is refused when it would leave a live snapshot or transaction outside the resulting window. **Undo and terminate hold the window too** (#1002): undoing a snapshot delete, replace or move, or a transaction delete, re-checks the restored month/day in the same transaction and refuses with `OUTSIDE_BOND_TERM`, nothing restored — a restored Buy that becomes the earliest Buy also checks the whole live history against its new window, like adding a first Buy later than existing entries; a lifecycle terminate refuses a termination month outside the window before the close snapshot is written, and a termination day outside it when it books a settlement Sell/Maturity (a bond with no live Buy gets only the maturity bound). Backup restore stays faithful to the backup and is not checked (ADR-0036). Archived rows count for nothing (an archived Buy opens no window, an archived snapshot blocks no edit). A bond with no live Buy (a `secondary_market` bond before its first purchase) has no lower bound — only the maturity upper bound and no-future apply. The frontend mirrors the bounds as `min`/`max` on the placement and maturity inputs (en + id copy for both codes) | `backend/internal/investments/bond_term_window_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/repo/bond_term_window_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/repo/undo_term_window_test.go`<br>`frontend/src/components/dialogs/BondTermWindow.test.tsx`<br>`frontend/src/components/dialogs/TerminatePositionDialog.test.tsx`<br>`frontend/src/lib/bondTerm.test.ts`<br>`frontend/src/lib/dateLimits.test.ts` |
